title: Conservative Hybrid Graph Networks for Process Systems with Learned Routing
abstract: arXiv:2608.28896v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Industrial process networks do not maintain a single effective topology while operating: streams are throttled or bypassed, and units move between idle, transition, and active regimes. Models of such systems are typically trained on measured state trajectories while the operating mechanisms that generated them remain latent, and an unconstrained graph network can fit such a trajectory without assigning stable physical meaning to the recovered routing. We address both problems with the Conservative Hybrid Graph Network (CHGN), which learns routing, regime assignment, and removal rates as data-driven surrogates and inserts them into a fixed transport equation, so that the mass balance holds by construction for any predicted routing. translated_title: 具有学习路由的流程系统保守混合图网络
translated_abstract: 工业过程网络在运行时并不保持单一的有效拓扑结构：流体会被节流或旁路，设备单元会在空闲、过渡和活跃状态之间切换。此类系统的模型通常是在测量的状态轨迹上训练的，而生成这些轨迹的运行机制仍然隐含未知，因此无约束的图网络可以拟合这样的轨迹，却不会为恢复出的路由赋予稳定的物理意义。我们提出保守混合图网络（CHGN）来解决这两个问题，它将路由、状态分配和移除速率作为数据驱动的代理进行学习，并将其嵌入固定的传输方程中，从而使得质量守恒对于任何预测的路由都通过构造得以保证。在10-20个节点的网络上训练的CHGN可以零样本迁移到25-40个节点的未见图上而无需重新训练，在相同协议下达到2.1e-3的RMSE，而GNN基线为6e-2到9e-2，并且……
tldr: 提出保守混合图网络（CHGN），将学习到的路由、状态分配和移除速率嵌入固定传输方程以通过构造保证质量守恒，在10-20节点网络上训练后可零样本迁移到25-40节点的未见图，RMSE比GNN基线低一个数量级以上。
en_tdlr: The Conservative Hybrid Graph Network (CHGN) embeds learned routing, regime assignment, and removal rates into a fixed transport equation so that mass balance holds by construction, enabling zero-shot transfer from 10-20 node training networks to 25-40 node unseen graphs with an order-of-magnitude lower RMSE than GNN baselines.
